name: Christmas Palooza
location: Fierce Church, 954 Brae Loch Rd, Grayslake IL 60030
raw: You're invited to a free community event! Christmas Palooza is a fun holiday party where families can play games, make crafts, eat festive treats, and visit with Santa. Sunday, December 13th from 11am to 12:30pm. Free lunch for the family, dessert bar, hot cocoa bar, gingerbread bounce house plus small preschool bounce house, games and crafts, photo with Santa, Rudolph dance and pinata. Event will be filmed and photographed.
notes: Free lunch, cocoa bar, bounce houses (one for preschoolers), crafts, photo with Santa, pinata.
